name: Legg-Calvé-Perthes Disease
definition: Idiopathic osteonecrosis of the femoral head epiphysis in children, leading to variable collapse and remodeling during growth.

redFlags.item: Severe acute systemic symptoms suggesting infection

investigations.principle: Serial imaging helps stage disease and guide containment decisions.
investigations.MRI: MRI can detect early disease before radiographic change.
investigations.radiographs: AP pelvis and frog-leg lateral radiographs are commonly used.

amber: Containment surgery is individualized by age, extent and stage.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Asthi-dhatu/hip developmental phenotype may be documented only as correlation.

patientEducation.summary: Idiopathic osteonecrosis of the femoral head epiphysis in children, leading to variable collapse and remodeling during growth.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
